title: How to Stop Procrastinating by Using the Two-Minute Rule
coreMove: Shrink the doorway to the habit until starting is too small to refuse.
sourcePressure: Procrastination weakens when the first move is reduced to a tiny, easy entry action, often framed as a two-minute version of the habit.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Pretending the two-minute version is the whole ambition rather than the entry ritual.
sourceAlignmentTerms: master the habit of showing up

hook: starting with a definition of two-minute rule
counterintuition: the problem is not motivation alone

exampleSpecs.domain: a court-appointed translator starting certification study by opening one audio file
exampleSpecs.audience: a translator who delays a high-stakes exam
exampleSpecs.stakes: whether the two-minute entry breaks the avoidance threshold
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: she presses play on a two-minute legal phrase clip before deciding whether to continue
exampleSpecs.firstImage: headphones resting on a certification binder

exampleSpecs.domain: a park ranger starting trail reports by photographing the first signpost
exampleSpecs.audience: a ranger who postpones long maintenance logs
exampleSpecs.stakes: whether the tiny first action starts the real route inspection
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: he snaps the trailhead sign and the report is officially open before the climb feels large
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a weathered trailhead sign in morning fog

exampleSpecs.domain: a bassist restarting practice by tuning one string
exampleSpecs.audience: a musician frozen by the full practice plan
exampleSpecs.stakes: whether a tiny ritual lowers the doorway into playing
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: his teacher says tune only the A string, and his hand continues into the scale after the tuner settles
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a clip-on tuner blinking above one string

exampleSpecs.domain: a small-claims plaintiff beginning paperwork by writing only the case number
exampleSpecs.audience: a tenant overwhelmed by legal forms
exampleSpecs.stakes: whether the entry action defeats paperwork dread
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: she writes the case number in the top box and is allowed to stop, which makes the next box less threatening
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a blank claim form under a courthouse pen chain

exampleSpecs.domain: a marathon volunteer starting cleanup by folding one barricade sign
exampleSpecs.audience: a race coordinator facing a mile of post-event mess
exampleSpecs.stakes: whether a two-minute first move turns paralysis into motion
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: she folds the first sign and radios the next zone instead of staring at the whole route
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a collapsed barricade sign on wet pavement

exampleSpecs.domain: a film archivist starting a digitization backlog by labeling one reel can
exampleSpecs.audience: an archivist avoiding a multi-year project
exampleSpecs.stakes: whether the first tiny catalog act opens the project without pretending to finish it
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: he labels one reel, logs the accession number, and stops before the task becomes a fantasy of catching up
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a metal film can under a small label maker

skillTargets: distinguish gateway rituals from final ambitions
use tiny starts to beat procrastination thresholds

tryThisNowSpec: Create a two-minute doorway version of one avoided habit and do only that version once today.
